Human Low (33 words): In one human trial, some clot stroke patients seemed to recover better on DMSO, and doctors have used it in a small series of patients to bring down dangerous pressure inside the skull.

Human Medium (36 words): But more relevant to the drug overdose issue this article deals with, in rat brain cells in a dish, DMSO quickly calmed the overstimulation by glutamate (through its NMDA and AMPA receptors) that kills brain cells.

AI-Assisted Low (15 words): The heart research on DMSO has only been in animals and lab dishes so far.

AI-Assisted Medium (34 words): Rats given DMSO for three days before a heart attack lost about three quarters less heart muscle than rats without it, though that study didn't try giving it after the attack had started.

AI-Assisted Low (36 words): Most heart attacks come from a clot blocking an artery, so it's a good sign that DMSO also slowed clotting, in mice and in human platelets (the blood cells that start clots) in a dish.
